description.value: HL7-defined code system of concepts specifying the HL7 (communications) error code. Used in the ERR segment in HL7 Version 2.x messaging.

purpose.value: Underlying Master Code System for V2 table 0357 (Message Error Condition Codes)

description.value: A code that indicates the status of the concept

valueString.value: Success. Optional, as the AA conveys success. Used for systems that must always return a status code.
Error: The message segments were not in the proper order, or required segments are missing.
Error: A required field is missing from a segment
Error: The field contained data of the wrong data type, e.g., an NM field contained "FOO".
Error: A field of data type ID or IS was compared against the corresponding table, and no match was found.
Error: a value exceeded the normative length, or the length that the application is able to safely handle.

definition.value: An error has been encountered related to HL7 message content. Message is not -conformant with the applicable specification’s (base standard, conformance profile or implementation profile) cardinality.

valueString.value: Error: Cardinality is listed as [0..3] and more than 3 of the identified element are present in the message.

definition.value: Any other error with the HL7 syntax that is not captured in any of the other error codes in this set.

valueString.value: Rejection: The Message Type is not supported.
Rejection: The Event Code is not supported.
Rejection: The Processing ID is not supported.
Rejection: The Version ID is not supported.

definition.value: Retained for backwards compatibility only: This situation should be reported in ERR-5 (Application Error Code) using code 101 (Unknown Key Identifier) from code system HL70533.

valueString.value: ERR-3 (HL7 Error Code) should be used to convey errors at the structural level and this is an application level error, which should be reported in ERR-5 (Application Error Code).

definition.value: Retained for backwards compatibility only: This situation should be reported in ERR-5 (Application Error Code) using code 102 (Duplicate Key Identifier) from code system HL70533.

valueString.value: ERR-3 (HL7 Error Code) should be used to convey errors at the structural level and this is an application level error, which should be reported in ERR-5 (Application Error Code).

definition.value: Retained for backwards compatibility only: This situation should be reported in ERR-5 (Application Error Code) using code 103 (Application record locked) from code system HL70533.

valueString.value: ERR-3 (HL7 Error Code) should be used to convey errors at the structural level and this is an application level error, which should be reported in ERR-5 (Application Error Code).

definition.value: An application level error has occurred and the detail for that error is identified in ERR-5.

valueString.value: This value is used when no other value in this list is applicable and there is an application error reported in ERR-5. It is applicable when ERR-3 is required in an implementation guide.
